source.stem: Which statement about the properties and uses of copper is correct?

options.text: It is used in electrical wiring, and it is ductile.
It is mixed with tin to make the alloy brass.
It is used in overhead electrical cables because it has a low density.
It is used in takeaway food containers because of its resistance to corrosion.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: A large area with only a few scattered plants is a forest if those plants give animals food and shelter.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Forests grow dense and varied plants because many animals need food and shelter there.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Forests are homes for large wild animals, but not for birds or insects.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: A green lawn is a forest home for many life forms because it is green.

intelligence.enrichment: Forests are large areas with dense growth of various types of plants. They are natural homes for many wild animals, including birds and insects, and provide food and shelter to them. Dense and varied plant growth creates food and shelter, so many animals and other life forms can survive in forests. The learner correctly applies this rule: Forests are large areas with dense growth of various types of plants. They are natural homes for many wild animals, including birds and insects, and provide food and shelter to them. A forest is just many trees grouped together.
